# namespace_builder_configuration (Data Source)

Reads remote builder placement, endpoints, and sizing without exposing credentials or pre-spawning instances.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    namespace = {
      source = "bsuv/namespace"
    }
  }
}

data "namespace_builder_configuration" "amd64" {
  platform = "linux/amd64"
}

output "builder_endpoint" {
  value = data.namespace_builder_configuration.amd64.buildkit_endpoint
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `builder_name` (String) Specific remote builder target name.
- `platform` (String) Target architecture platform (e.g. `linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`).

### Read-Only

- `buildkit_endpoint` (String) Host and port endpoint for connecting to BuildKit.
- `cache_size_mb` (Number) Size of the builder cache volume in megabytes.
- `full_buildkit_endpoint` (String) Full URI with scheme and port for connecting to BuildKit.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the builder configuration in Terraform state.
- `server_ca_pem` (String) PEM-encoded server CA certificates for verifying the remote builder.
- `shape` (Attributes) Instance sizing and compute shape of the builder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--shape))

<a id="nestedatt--shape"></a>
### Nested Schema for `shape`

Read-Only:

- `machine_arch` (String) Architecture (`amd64`, `arm64`).
- `memory_megabytes` (Number) RAM in megabytes.
- `os` (String) OS family (`linux`, `macos`).
- `virtual_cpu` (Number) Number of virtual CPUs.
